decision: confirmed the plan's core claim: a coordination-free CRDT or OT cannot enforce last-unit exclusion
why: Bailis invariant confluence, CALM, and Balegas all say a stock floor needs coordination or escrowed quota

decision: found the plan overstates the CRDT claim
why: bounded counters can represent a floor by partitioning decrement rights, so the accurate claim is about last-unit exclusion, not counters in general

decision: found a real defect risk in the upload path
why: the authority rejects sequence gaps, so a client that fires all pending commands at once will produce spurious gap errors under packet loss
result: engine needs a stated send window, open

decision: queued a cheaper snapshot shape
why: Linear, Electric and Raft all publish a snapshot that may be behind head and let the client pull-complete the remainder, instead of copy-repair-freeze under live writes
